title: 2027 Strategy& Graduate Programme - Dublin
description: **Bring your talent. Learn new skills. Make a positive impact.** At PwC Ireland, we uncover hidden talents, build lifelong relationships, and turn challenges into opportunities. We redefine possibilities for our clients and communities, empowering you to make a meaningful impact that extends far beyond our firm. As part of our team—whether in Assurance, Tax, Specialised Assurance Services, or Consulting & Deals—you’ll engage in impactful projects with leading clients across diverse industries, contributing to the shaping of tomorrow. From your first day, you’ll be immersed in a collaborative and inclusive culture where your ideas lead to real-world solutions. Our graduate programme supports your growth at every stage, combining hands-on experience with structured learning, professional qualifications, and mentorship. This is your chance to grow, innovate, and contribute meaningfully as we work towards excellence together. **Application deadline: This role will be closed at 2pm on** **30th October 2026** **Role Overview:** Strategy& is a global strategy consulting firm that is part of the professional services network of PwC. Strategy& has a network of 75+ offices with 4500+ consultants around the world. Strategy& benefits from the broad expertise and international reach of the wider PwC network. The Strategy& Dublin practice helps organisations develop and implement effective strategies to achieve their goals and objectives. We address key CEO questions on issues such as growth strategy, market entry, mergers and acquisitions, organisation design, performance improvement and value creation. The Strategy& Graduate Programme provides a structured learning environment to help you develop the skills and capabilities required of a top-tier strategy consultant. Our programme includes on-the-job learning (via hands-on project experience), learning from others (via Buddy, Coach and Mentor), and formal learning (via induction and regular training sessions). Your first two weeks are induction, which teaches you the basics and develops your network with the Strategy& and PwC intakes. After the initial two weeks training, you will join project teams and become a core contributor. You will take ownership of defined pieces of analysis and project deliverables, with guidance and support from experienced team members. You will have the opportunity to contribute to discussions in internal meetings with senior team members and will have your voice and opinions valued. Your responsibilities will grow as your experience develops, giving you the opportunity to make meaningful contributions from an early stage in your career. Day-to-day, you will work closely with colleagues across different levels of experience, combining analytical thinking, structured problem solving and effective communication to help solve complex client challenges. You will contribute to team discussions, share your perspectives and learn how to translate data and qualitative insights into practical recommendations that create real client impact. **Typical Graduate responsibilities include:** Taking ownership of defined workstreams and project deliverables, while receiving coaching, feedback and support from experienced members of the project team. Identifying relevant data sources and collecting, interpreting and analysing data to generate insights that support strategic recommendations. Conducting interviews and deriving insight from qualitative inputs. Working with project teams to break down complex business problems, test potential solutions and develop practical recommendations for clients Supporting the development of client-ready presentations and communicating findings to colleagues, clients and senior stakeholders as your confidence and experience grow. Building commercial awareness and developing an understanding of the challenges and opportunities facing organisations across a broad range of industries. Contributing to the wider Strategy& team through internal initiatives, collaboration, knowledge-sharing and other activities that support the growth and success of the business. All new joiners are each assigned a buddy who will be responsible for helping you settle in and be there to answer any questions you may have. Alongside this, you will also have a career coach, who will serve as a mentor and support you to ensure you get the opportunities to develop and progress your career at Strategy&. **Who We’re Looking For:** Our Graduates join us from a range of backgrounds, but all are intellectually curious and highly motivated. We also look for people who bring something more to our work than their academic credentials. For example, the self-discipline and team-working skills or leadership qualities gained through work, sporting and volunteering experience. You have a strong academic record and good analytical and problem-solving skills (minimum 2.1 degree or equivalent) As a Graduate, you’ll be able to exercise commercial awareness, analytical and interpersonal skills in your day-to-day work. Over time, you’ll build the confidence and credibility to present your opinions to clients and senior stakeholders. **Our commitment to you!** At PwC, we recognise that every graduate's journey is unique, and we're committed to supporting your professional growth with benefits that align with your lifestyle and aspirations. Our flexible benefits plan enables you to customise your package, ensuring it meets your individual needs. Whether you're looking to enhance your skills, maintain a healthy work-life balance, or prepare for the future, we provide the tools and resources to help you succeed. Find out more here. If you require reasonable accommodations during the application or interview process or to perform essential job functions, please contact us at ie\_ireland.graduate@pwc.com. **Grow your career with PwC Ireland.**

title: Asset Wealth Management Operations - Investment Management Oversight Analyst - Dublin
description: **Job Description** Goldman Sachs Fund Services Limited (GSAMFSL) acts as management company and global distributor for a range of UCITS and alternative investment funds. The Investment Management Oversight team provides independent monitoring and constructive challenge of portfolio management delegates, assessing performance, adherence to investment mandates and processes, key investment risks, delegate controls and compliance with applicable policies and regulatory expectations. The Analyst will support the Investment Management Designated Person by reviewing quantitative and qualitative information, participating in delegate oversight meetings and due diligence reviews, identifying emerging issues, and tracking remediation through to closure. The role will help produce evidence-based reporting, escalation and recommendations for senior management, governance committees and the Board. It offers broad exposure to Portfolio Management, Trading, Investment Risk, Product Development, Legal, Compliance, Operations and other stakeholders across the GSAM business, including involvement in new product and material fund change assessments from an investment oversight perspective. **Primary Responsibilities** * Analyse portfolio performance, risk indicators, investment guideline adherence and investment-process outcomes across the GS fund range * Perform periodic and thematic reviews of internal and external portfolio management delegates, including initial and ongoing due diligence * Assess investment performance and persistent underperformance, liquidity, leverage, concentration, derivatives and counterparty exposures, sustainability risk and relevant product commitments * Review matters relating to best execution, trading, valuation, securities financing, collateral arrangements, stressed portfolio conditions and investment breaches * Challenge delegates on exceptions, adverse trends, control weaknesses and the quality, completeness and timeliness of delegate reporting * Maintain delegate oversight plans, risk assessments, due diligence records, issues and actions, and track remediation through to closure * Prepare clear management information, conclusions and recommendations for the Investment Management Designated Person, senior management, governance committees and the Board * Identify, document and escalate material issues, including conflicts of interest arising from affiliated delegates and risks associated with sub-delegation arrangements * Review relevant policies, procedures and controls, assess their effectiveness and contribute to the continued development of the GSAMFSL investment oversight framework * Contribute to new product approvals and material fund change assessments by evaluating portfolio management arrangements, investment risks and oversight readiness **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience * At least one year of experience in financial services, asset management, investment risk, compliance, audit, fund governance or a related control function * Ability to analyse performance, risk and portfolio data and translate complex information into concise governance reporting * Ability to build effective relationships and provide constructive challenge to delegates and senior stakeholders * Strong judgement, attention to detail and ability to identify issues, escalate concerns and follow remediation through to completion * Strong organisational, business writing, communication and time-management skills * Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines and adapt in a fast-paced and dynamic environment **Preferred Qualifications** * Knowledge of UCITS and/or alternative investment fund structures and the role of a management company in overseeing delegated portfolio management * Understanding of investment products, portfolio-management concepts and relevant investment risks * Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills; exposure to data visualisation, reporting automation or portfolio analytics tools would be beneficial * Experience in a control-focused role or front-office environment * CFA qualification, progress towards the qualification or willingness to undertake relevant professional development **About Goldman Sachs** At Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world. We are a family business, established in 1989 and have been selling beautiful homewares exclusively within the BTA group for 35 years. We have established great relationships with our loyal customers, and each member of our team knows the importance of superb customer service, thorough product knowledge and a flair for selling beautiful things. **KNOW THE ROLE** The role involves selling and customer relations, merchandising the ranges, stock control, learning all about our beautiful products and all the tasks involved with running a retail concession. **Know What We’re Looking For** We are looking for a new member to join our small team in Arnotts. The ideal candidate will love selling, be efficient, trustworthy, and hardworking with a flair for interiors and a love of homewares being a distinct advantage. We would require the new team member to ideally have a background in sales / interiors, although this is not a necessity. A positive attitude is most important, as is a willingness to work hard at all aspects of the job, and to really enjoy the interactions with our customers, whilst being professional, quick, and cheerful in carrying out all the tasks needed in the retail environment. They must be willing to be flexible with working hours as demands shift with the seasons, including Sundays, late night shopping evenings etc. **Know How We Work** **Experience is our business:** Our customer engagement sets the bar in service and experiential retail, giving our customers something to love every time. **We Are More Than Shops:** We create enjoyable places, to excite, where people socialise, discover, learn and are inspired, and where local communities are enriched. **We are Curators:** Our unique range of product and services are key to the sense of excitement that Brown Thomas Arnotts is renowned for, whether for a special day or every day, things that make our customer’s lives better. **We Care for Our People:** We believe a great customer experience starts with a great people experience. title: Business Development Graduate - January 2027

title: Business Development Representative
description: **About the Company** We're partnering with a fast-growing SaaS company that is building momentum across **Western Europe and the US** . Having established a strong foundation as a seed-stage business, the company is now entering an exciting phase of growth, with plans to scale significantly ahead of a planned Series A funding round next year. With a growing customer base, ambitious leadership team, and a product solving real business challenges, this is an opportunity to join at a stage where your impact will be visible from day one. **About the Role** As a Business Development Representative, you'll join a high-performing team of six BDRs and report directly to the Sales Team Lead. Your focus will be generating qualified pipeline through outbound activity and opening conversations with prospective customers across international markets. This role is ideal for someone who loves the challenge of outbound sales, enjoys hunting for new opportunities, and isn't afraid to put in the work required to stand out. The team values energy, resilience, curiosity, and people who proactively create opportunities rather than wait for them to arrive. **Key Responsibilities** * Generate qualified sales opportunities through outbound prospecting via phone, email, LinkedIn, and other channels. * Research target accounts and identify key decision-makers across Western Europe and the US. * Build and execute personalised outreach campaigns. * Qualify prospects and schedule meetings for the Account Executive team. * Develop a strong understanding of customer challenges and business needs. * Maintain accurate CRM records and activity tracking. * Partner closely with Account Executives to build account strategies and drive pipeline creation. * Consistently achieve and exceed activity, meeting, and pipeline targets. * Contribute ideas and best practices to improve team performance and outbound effectiveness. **About You** * 6-18 months' experience in a BDR, SDR, Business Development, or Sales Development role. * Previous SaaS experience is essential. * Experience working within an early-stage startup, ideally a seed-stage business, would be highly advantageous. * Exposure to a founding team environment or experience helping build processes, pipeline, or go-to-market functions from an early stage is highly desirable. * Proven track record of meeting or exceeding activity and pipeline generation targets. * Comfortable with high-volume outbound prospecting across phone, email, and LinkedIn. * Strong communication skills with the confidence to engage senior stakeholders. * Naturally curious, resilient, and highly driven. * Thrives in fast-paced environments where things move quickly and priorities can change. * Enjoys building from the ground up rather than operating within heavily structured environments. * Motivated by growth, progression, and being part of a company's success story. * Excited by the hustle, ownership, and energy that come with scaling a startup. **What You'll Get** * Competitive base salary and uncapped commission structure. * The opportunity to join a rapidly growing SaaS company before its next major growth phase. * Continuous coaching, mentorship, and development. * Clear progression opportunities into Account Executive roles as the business scales. * Exposure to international markets across Western Europe and North America. * A collaborative, ambitious, and supportive team culture. **Why Join?** This is an opportunity to join a company that genuinely values people who roll up their sleeves, back themselves, and make things happen. You'll be part of a small but mighty team that celebrates success, learns quickly, and moves fast. If you're someone who loves the buzz of outbound sales, gets a kick out of creating opportunities from scratch, and wants to grow with a business that has big ambitions, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Butcher - Avoca, Dunboyne
description: Avoca operates in 14 locations across the country. After all this time, the ethos of Avoca remains the same. We cherish our time-honoured traditions, which have been lovingly passed down through several generations. Our skills might be steeped in a long and rich tradition, but our attitude is to look to the future. We are now heralded as one of Ireland's most exciting retail stores, with a host of award-winning cafes, restaurants and food markets crammed with artisanal ingredients from near and far. **Butcher - Avoca Dunboyne** **Job Specification** As an Avoca Butcher, you are responsible for supporting the Butcher Team in delivering consistently high-quality butcher products in various Avoca branches as required. **Key Responsibilities** Preparing and presenting butcher product in accordance with approved recipes and to a very high standard. Following all HACCP and food safety regulations, as well as any additional in-house SOPs, labelling requirements etc. Preparation and production of butcher product to be sent to Avoca stores in line with internal ordering processes and procedures. Excellent customer service, for both internal and external customers. Communication - Due to the changeable nature of this role, regular communication is required between you and your line manager in order to maximize efficiency. Flexibility - The nature of the business is dependent on customer service which requires certain aspects of flexibility such as roster changes, cover on days that are short-staffed in all areas of the butcher sections as needed. You will be notified of these changes by your line manager High Standards of Quality - A consistent level of quality is required, in keeping with Avoca high standards in all stores. **Why work with us?** We're always on the lookout for likeminded folks to join our merry band of men and women. So, apart from coming to work with your amazing teammates every day, we also offer the following benefits: * Pension Scheme * Professional Development * Employee Assistance Programme * Employee Share Purchase Plan * Employee Referral Bonus * Family Friendly Policies * Life Assurance Benefit * Cycle To Work Scheme * Health & Wellness Programmes

title: Cleaning Operative - Eve/Nights

It’s where our skilled Manufacturing and Logistics teams work together to make and distribute our delicious, freshly made doughnuts to stores and cabinets across the country every day. Located in Monread Industrial Estate, just off the N7, the factory is a fast-paced, collaborative, and exciting place to work — where every doughnut begins its journey to spreading joy. **Why you'll love working here** At Krispy Kreme, we're all about making every moment a little brighter and that starts with our people. Alongside a great culture, you'll enjoy a range of benefits including: * A welcoming and inclusive team * Paid training from day one * Learning and development opportunities * Career progression across our growing business * Employee discount * Holiday pay * Health & Wellbeing support * Recognition for great work * Uniform provided * And of course... delicious Krispy Kreme doughnuts! title: Corporate Reception And Security Officer
description: At Manguard Plus, we believe great security is about much more than standing at a door. It's about creating welcoming environments, supporting people, solving problems, and helping everyone feel safe. We're looking for confident, approachable and professional people to join our Corporate Security team in Dublin. Whether you already work in security or have experience in customer service, hospitality, healthcare, reception, retail, aviation, administration, or another people-focused role, we'd love to hear from you. Women continue to be underrepresented in the security industry, and we're committed to changing that by creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to succeed. If you've never considered a career in security before, this could be the perfect opportunity. **No PSA Licence? We'll Help You Get Started** You don't need to hold a current PSA Licence to apply. Security experience is welcome, but it isn't essential. Many of our successful officers have backgrounds in: * Customer Service * Hospitality * Reception and Front of House * Healthcare * Retail * Administration * Aviation * Events * Facilities Management * Corporate Offices If you've worked with people, enjoy providing excellent service, and want to build a rewarding career, we'd love to hear from you. **Why Join Manguard Plus?** * Supportive and inclusive working environment. * Full training provided. * PSA Licence support for suitable candidates. * Opportunities for career progression. * Professional corporate workplace. * A role where communication and customer service are valued as highly as security experience. * Be part of a diverse team where everyone is respected and encouraged to succeed. * Everyone is Welcome At Manguard Plus, we're committed to building a workforce that reflects the communities we serve. We actively encourage applications from women, people returning to work, career changers, and individuals from all backgrounds and experiences. If you have the right attitude, enjoy working with people, and want to build a career where you can make a genuine difference every day, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Creative Content Specialist
description: **Company:** The Sales Circle **Job Type:** Full-Time About The Sales Circle The Sales Circle is a fast-growing tech sales education and career development company helping ambitious people break into tech sales and accelerate their careers. We've helped over 350 people secure roles at some of the world's leading technology companies, and we're on a mission to build something much bigger. Content plays a massive role in how we grow our business, build our community and tell the stories of the people we help. We're now looking for a **talented, ambitious and highly creative individual** to join our team and take our content to the next level. The Role We're looking for someone who is much more than just a videographer or video editor. While **videography and editing will be your primary responsibilities** , you'll also be heavily involved in the creative direction, storytelling, content strategy and overall development of our brand. You'll work closely with the founders to create compelling content across The Sales Circle's business channels and their personal brands. This role is perfect for someone who loves creating content, understands what makes people pay attention and wants to develop their skills while taking on increasing levels of ownership and responsibility. We don't want someone who simply waits to be told what to film or edit. **We want someone who brings ideas to the table, challenges how we do things and takes pride in producing exceptional work.** Key Responsibilities1. Videography & Video Editing * Film and edit engaging, high-quality content for Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube and other digital platforms. * Produce short-form and long-form content, including educational videos, founder-led content, testimonials, behind-the-scenes footage, events and storytelling pieces. * Manage the video production process from planning and filming through to editing and final delivery. * Ensure all content is visually engaging, professionally produced and aligned with our brand identity. * Continuously experiment with new editing styles, formats and storytelling techniques. 2. Creative Direction & Content Strategy * Collaborate closely with the founders on the creative direction of The Sales Circle and their personal brands. * Proactively pitch new content ideas, concepts, series and campaigns. * Develop engaging storylines and creative angles that resonate with our audience. * Stay ahead of emerging social media trends, formats and creative opportunities. * Help build a recognisable and consistent visual identity across our channels. * Contribute to the bigger picture of how content drives brand awareness, audience growth and business results. 3. Storytelling & Content Development * Turn everyday business activities, customer successes, founder experiences and events into compelling stories. * Structure content with strong hooks, engaging narratives and clear messaging. * Identify opportunities to capture content that others might overlook. * Communicate our brand's personality, values and mission through creative storytelling. 4. AI & Creative Innovation * Actively use AI tools to improve the quality, efficiency and creativity of our content production. * Use AI-powered editing, content ideation, production workflows and creative tools. * Continuously explore new technologies that could give our content a competitive advantage. * Help us build smarter, more efficient creative processes through automation and AI. 5. Content Organisation & Production Management * Own and maintain an organised content production workflow. * Manage filming schedules, content calendars, deadlines and deliverables. * Organise and maintain a structured library of footage, projects and creative assets. * Ensure content moves efficiently from idea to production to publication. * Balance multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining a consistently high standard of work. **Organisation is a non-negotiable part of this role.** We want someone who brings structure to the creative process, rather than someone who needs to be constantly managed. What We're Looking For * **Storytelling:** You understand what makes content interesting and know how to turn ideas into engaging narratives. * **Video editing:** You're confident producing polished, engaging content and understand pacing, sound, visuals and audience retention. * **Videography:** You're comfortable operating cameras, managing lighting, capturing audio and producing professional footage. * **AI proficiency:** You're already comfortable using AI tools and genuinely excited about how AI is changing content creation. * **Creativity:** You consistently generate original ideas and aren't afraid to experiment. * **Independent thinking:** You're proactive, resourceful and comfortable making decisions without constant direction. * **Organisation:** You can manage multiple projects, meet deadlines and maintain clear systems. * **Ambition:** You're eager to learn, improve and take on greater responsibility. * **Ownership:** You take pride in your work and genuinely care about the quality and impact of what you create. Who This Role Is Perfect For This role would suit someone who: * Is genuinely passionate about filmmaking, storytelling, social media and content creation. * Loves creating content but also wants to understand the strategy and business thinking behind it. * Can take an idea from a conversation and turn it into a finished piece of content without needing detailed instructions. * Is constantly learning, experimenting and finding better ways to do things. * Thrives in a fast-moving entrepreneurial environment. * Wants to be challenged, trusted and given real responsibility. * Has ambitions to grow into a senior creative role as the business scales. We Care About Ability, Not Qualifications **We don't care whether you're 18 or 38. We don't care if you have a university degree.** What matters to us is your ability, creativity, work ethic and ambition. If you're young, hungry, talented and have the confidence to back yourself, we want to hear from you. Equally, if you've already built experience and want an opportunity to take on more responsibility, we'd love to hear from you too. We care far more about **what you can create and what you're capable of becoming** than what's written on your CV. Growth Opportunities We're building The Sales Circle for the long term, and we want someone who sees this as an opportunity to grow alongside the business. Initially, the focus will be on producing exceptional video content and improving our creative output. Over time, there will be opportunities to take on greater responsibility for: * Overall creative direction and brand identity. * Content strategy across multiple social platforms. * Developing and managing creative campaigns. * Building more sophisticated AI-powered content workflows. * Potentially leading a larger creative team as the business grows. **We're not looking for someone who simply wants to edit videos all day. We're looking for someone who wants to become a key part of building a brand.** How to Apply We're much more interested in seeing your work than reading a perfectly polished CV. Please submit: **Your portfolio:** Examples of video content you've filmed, edited or created.

title: Credit Control Agent (Energy)
description: **About the role:** Flogas Energy is looking to recruit proactive and detail-oriented Credit and Collections Agents to join our growing team in the dynamic Energy Market. This is a key role in supporting the expansion of our business and customer base, working closely with the credit control team to manage cash collections, handle customer queries, and ensure the smooth operation of credit activities. **Key Responsibilities:** * Manage the collection of payments from Commercial and Domestic accounts, ensuring timely and accurate processing. * Ensure strict compliance with the company's Credit Policy in all credit control activities. * Initiate and manage outbound calls to follow up on outstanding payments. * Consistently meet and exceed targets related to cash collections, recovery rates, and other key performance indicators. * Refer overdue accounts to debt collection agencies and initiate legal action where necessary. * Work with customers to create and manage payment plans for both Domestic and Commercial accounts. * Maintain oversight of outstanding debtor balances, ensuring accurate tracking and resolution of aged debts. * Respond to customer inquiries promptly, investigating and resolving account-related issues. * Handle customer communications via email and phone, ensuring a high standard of service. * Perform general administrative tasks as required. * Investigate unresolved debt issues, escalating them where necessary to ensure timely resolution. * Assist with various additional tasks and projects as needed to support the credit control function. **Candidate Profile:** The ideal candidate will have 1-2 years of experience working in busy credit control environment. They will possess a strong working knowledge of the collection process and be driven by targets and results. They will be team orientated and also competent to work on their own initiative, always seeking to improve individual performance. This person will need excellent customer service skills, demonstrating clear communication- both written and verbal. **About Flogas:** Part of the DCC Group, Flogas Ireland was established in 1978 supplying Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) throughout the island and to this day remains one of the leading suppliers in Ireland, servicing a diverse range of market sectors, including commercial, agricultural, and domestic. Over the years, Flogas has evolved and grown as an Energy business, and with the acquisition of Budget Energy, based in Derry, and Flogas Enterprise Solutions, (formally known as Naturgy) we are now also a leading supplier of Natural Gas and Electricity, as well as Renewables, including Corporate Power Purchase Agreements, and energy services in both residential and commercial markets across the island of Ireland. We have an esteemed reputation within the Energy Industry and have been awarded the NSAI Quality System Certificate from the I.S. EN ISO 9001 Series. As a Flogas Group, we are now driving our growth strategy to achieve our vision of being Irelands leading provider of total energy solutions, meeting our customers changing needs and delivering to the highest possible standard. **Why work with us?** Flogas is a well-established business within the DCC group and is continuing to grow, becoming a top provider in the energy sector, making it a very exciting time to be part of the Flogas Group. We offer a warm and welcoming environment, valuing our people and their input into the business. We encourage a collaborative workplace, where everyone feels included and heard. **Benefits:** * Competitive Salary * Defined contribution pension scheme * Heath Insurance * Staff discounts * Hybrid work options (role dependant) * Health and Wellbeing Supports * Learning and Development * Career Advancement is important to us in Flogas. All our roles are advertised internally, and we encourage internal progression right across the business. Flogas is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Customer Assistant Nights (Permanent 30-35 Hours) - Clarehall
description: **About the role** We pride ourselves on offering customers the biggest range of products around. And that's not just food, but everything from clothes and kettles to financial services. But did you know we offer the biggest job opportunities too? With stores across the UK and Ireland, and a variety of roles, we are always looking for people who are as passionate about helping customers as we are. Our Every Little Helps approach doesn't just apply to our customers. It's at the very heart of everything we do at work – and it's what makes us different. We believe in treating each other with respect, and everyone having the opportunity to get on. That's what makes Tesco such a great place to work **Should you be successful in your application, your offer will be subject to and conditional upon you providing your bank account details before your agreed start date.** **You will be responsible for** * Always put the customer first and consider them in everything you do. * Get to know your customers and serve them with pride. * Help to ensure products and services are available for customers at all times. * Handle all products with care to maintain quality and ensure they reach the customer in the best condition. * Keep the shop floor and back areas clean and tidy at all times. * Using the training you receive, follow department routines and processes. * Follow all company policies and adhere to Health and Safety routines. * Whilst you will have a core role, you may be asked to support your colleagues by helping in other departments. **You will need** * Able to give great, natural customer service by proactively smiling, greeting, acknowledging and helping customers. * Works hard for customers, your team and your department. * You are able to prioritise to ensure anything you do is right for our customers. * Adaptable and resilient to meet the ever changing demands of our business. * You must be able to follow instructions either verbal or written. * You are reliable and a good timekeeper. * You must be smart and tidy at all times. **Whats in it for you?** We offer excellent benefits that help make Tesco a great place to work. These include but aren’t limited to: * Competitive Salary * Bonus Scheme\* * Our Virtual GP service provides free and confidential access to an online GP through video GP consultations, and online prescription service for colleagues. The service is also available to families of colleagues who live at the same address for a reduced cost. * 24/7 access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for you and family members for in the moment emotional support along with free access to a range of wellbeing services supporting you under our new Wellbeing First approach of Body, Mind and Life. * Colleague Clubcard offering 10% discount across stores and online, with 15% discount weekends once a month (Friday to Sunday), and 20% off twice a year. There is also 20% off F&F clothing, all year long, these various discounts can be extended to a family member with a 2 nd Clubcard available.\* * Life Assurance * Pension Plan\* * Save As You Earn Scheme\* * Paid Family Leave * Bike to Work * Long Service Awards * Commuter Scheme \*Entry requirements and rules of the scheme apply **About Us** Our vision at Tesco is to become every customer’s favourite way to shop, whether they are at home or out on the move. Our core purpose is “Serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day”. Serving means more than a transactional relationship with our customers. It means acting as a responsible and sustainable business for all stakeholders, for the communities we are part of, and for the planet. Through initiatives like the Tesco Community Fund, our association with Children’s Health Foundation, our partnership with FoodCloud and our Stronger Starts programme, we have supported over 21,000 community groups, raised over €7.5 million for medical equipment, and provided almost 15 million meals nationwide, to those living in food insecurity. Tesco has operated in the Irish retail market since 1997, and with 190+ stores nationwide, we employ over 13,000 people in cities and towns around Ireland, supporting almost 45,000 jobs directly and indirectly. We partner with over 500 Irish suppliers - of which almost three-quarters are small and medium enterprises - which in turn supports almost 13,000 farming families around Ireland. Tesco is the single largest buyer of Irish food and drink in the world, buying €1.6 Billion a year; more than any other single country in the European Union, more than even the USA which you perceive as a massive buyer of Irish food. We work closely with suppliers across Ireland who are dedicated to making the best products for our customers and this is reflected in the numerous awards our products have won over the years including Blás Na hÉireann, World Steak Challenge and Great Taste Awards. We are proud to have an inclusive culture at Tesco where everyone truly feels able to be themselves. It is embedded in our values: we treat people how they want to be treated. At Tesco, we not only celebrate diversity, but recognise the value and opportunity it brings. We always want our colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work and we are committed to helping them be at their best. We know life looks a little different for each of us. That’s why at Tesco, we always welcome chats about flexible working. Some people are at the start of their careers, some want the freedom to do the things they love. Others are going through life-changing moments like becoming a carer, nearing retirement, adapting to parenthood, or something else. So, talk to us throughout your application about how we can support. Tesco is committed to celebrating diversity and everyone is welcome at Tesco. We're committed to providing a fully inclusive recruitment process, allowing candidates the opportunity to thrive and inform us of any reasonable adjustments they may require. For further information on the accessibility support we can offer, please click http://roi.tesco-careers.com/accessibility/ **How can I let Tesco know I need additional support?** Please let us know you need additional support by emailing **tescoireland.recruitment@tesco.ie** This will allow us to understand more about you and how we can best support you through the recruitment process.

title: Customer Service Agent - Travel Insurance
description: Job Type: Permanent - Full Time Location: Dublin, Ireland Job Category: Call Centre and Customer Service **Job Description** Where will your career take you next? title: Graduate Development Programme - Purchasing Operations
description: **Summary** From our Head Office to the shop floor and everywhere in between our primary goal is to create and deliver a fantastic customer journey for everyone who shops at Lidl. With over 7,000 colleagues across our stores, warehouses and offices in Ireland and Northern Ireland we are a big and ambitious team. We know our people are our greatest asset and our success is down to the commitment and dedication of our team. **Training and Development** At Lidl, your career isn’t just a job- it’s an investment. We’re big on growth, and we give you all the support, structure, and hands-on experience you need to level up both personally and professionally. As the **only City & Guilds/ILM Accredited Graduate Programme in Ireland** , our 18-month Graduate Management Development Programme is built entirely around *you* . **What makes it different?** * Tailored To You: Enjoy a bespoke training plan mapped to your unique skills and long-term career goals. * Real-World Experience: Get stuck into our stores and distribution centers to learn the heart of our business from the ground up. * Blended Learning: Experience dynamic, structured on-the-job training combined with industry-leading modules. We don't just hire graduates- we build future leaders. Ready to launch yours? **Purchasing Operations** The Purchasing Operations department is part of the wider Commercial team and plays an important role in ensuring that products are available in stores and maintained in all systems of the business. Purchasing Operations works closely with buyers and suppliers across Ireland to ensure that the product information is maintained as agreed. Whilst working in the Purchasing Operations department, you will work in a fast-paced environment while ensuring high quality standards. You will be working collaboratively with different departments to ensure that contracts are completed on time, and that the item data is maintained in our various systems correctly. Our customers will only be able to find their favourite products in stores if all tasks are completed in a timely manner. In addition to the everyday tasks, the Purchasing Operations department continuously improves systems and processes at all levels of the business to ensure that they are matching the international standards. Change management and innovation are key for working on projects that affect staff, suppliers, and our customers. You will not only work with colleagues within Lidl Ireland but also find yourself collaborating with Lidl colleagues all around Europe. You will have the opportunity to work in various teams and learn how to manage your own time and resources effectively. During the programme you will work in all departments within Purchasing Operations; Contract Management, Master Data, Orga Projects and Price Analysis. This will allow you to learn different aspects of our operations. What you'll need * An expected or attained 2.1 Honours Level 8 degree * Full driver’s license is required * Flexibility to travel within Ireland is required * Motivation and drive * Strong personal skills * Work experience or experience abroad * German is an advantage but not a necessity What you'll receive We offer a competitive and transparent salary system, that ensures pay equality across all positions at Lidl * €45,500 per annum pro rata * 20 days holidays per annum pro rata * Private employee medical insurance * Flexible start and finish times * City & Guilds/ILM assured programme * Initial training and on-going development from an experienced team member * Responsibility for and involvement in projects with real business impact * Excellent opportunities for career progression * Bespoke training plan depending on current skills and career path * One-to-one coaching available from a qualified coach in the business * A vast array of training and development opportunities from our in-house training catalogue including Leadership Development Programmes * Masterclasses with renowned business experts * Director and graduate mentorship programme * Modern office facility with free parking * On-site gym and canteen * Up to 2 days remote working per week * Mobile and broadband discounts with Three network * Unlock a flex pot allowance to spend on a selection of benefits after 6 months of service Lidl is an equal opportunities employer. title: Onboarding Specialist
description: **About the role** Supermetrics helps marketing teams get their data out of the platforms they advertise on and into the tools where they report and make decisions. Most of our customers start on their own through self-serve. Some of them get stuck along the way, and today we can't reliably tell which ones are stuck and which ones are simply moving at their own pace. This role exists to change that. You will own proactive outreach to self-serve customers during onboarding, and you will assist in delivering onboarding for our 1:1 approach. You will also help build the model that decides which customers need which kind of support. That model is being built now, so you will shape it rather than inherit it. **What you will do** * Run risk-based outreach to self-serve customers. This covers one-to-many communications for most customers and one-to-one contact where a customer's potential warrants it. * Diagnose why a customer is stuck. It could be a technical blocker, a use case mismatch, or not yet understanding the value. Hand genuinely technical issues to our Implementation Architects with clear context. * Help design and refine the risk-tiering model that triggers outreach, and give input on the AI and agentic tooling that supports customers getting started. * Feed patterns you see back to Product, Support and Customer Success, so that fixable friction gets fixed rather than repeated. * Assist in the delivery of 1:1 onboarding where needed. **What you will bring** * Ideally 1-2 years in a customer-facing role, such as sales development, onboarding, customer success or technical support. * Familiarity with performance marketing and the tooling used such as ad platforms, analytics tools and reporting destinations will be a huge plus! * Comfort using data to spot trends and prioritise your own time across a large book of customers. * Clear, plain written communication, since much of your outreach will reach many customers at once. * Curiosity about automation and AI, and a practical view of where a person adds more value than a sequence does. **Nice to have** * Experience with a CRM system * A background at a marketing agency or in-house marketing team. * A second European language. **What success looks like in the first six months** * Self-serve and Scaled customers are visible to the team every week, rather than only surfacing when they churn. * A first version of the risk-tiering model is agreed and in use. **Benefits we offer…** * Competitive compensation package, including equity * Great work equipment, and home office allowance for those working in our fully remote locations * Health care benefit and leisure time insurance * Annual 1000 euros of personal learning budget * Sports and wellbeing allowance Benefits may vary depending on location. Hear why our team likes it here at supermetrics.com/careers/life-at-supermetrics. **Join us in putting AI to work for marketers** Supermetrics helps marketers make better decisions. It connects marketing data from platforms like Facebook Ads and Google Analytics to the AI tools, analytics tools, and data warehouses marketers already use, putting it right where they need it. With Supermetrics, a marketer can connect their data to AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT, ask questions about their campaigns, and get insights and recommendations grounded in live data. From there, they can also manage and update campaigns across every connected platform, automatically and in one place, using guardrails to stay in control. We work with organizations of every size: small teams that want enterprise-level reporting without the overhead, global brands like Dyson and L'Oréal that need visibility across millions in ad spend, and agencies like dentsu and McCann UK that manage large portfolios of client accounts at scale. In total, over 200,000 businesses trust Supermetrics to help them make the best decisions with their marketing data. We've grown from a one-person shop in 2013 into a global powerhouse, and we're only getting started. Today, we're 300+ people, with teams spread across 10 countries and 3 continents. Our team represents more than 50 nationalities which makes us a multicultural, collaborative, thriving team. Supermetrics operates on trust, transparency, and a keen customer focus. Forward-looking and quick to act, we see what needs doing, take ownership, and run with it. As team players, we help each other and win together. We're hiring for a diverse, skilled, and collaborative team and building an inclusive workplace where everyone is treated fairly and respectfully. It all started with a Google t-shirt... Read the rest of our story at supermetrics.com/about. **How we use AI in the recruitment process:** We use AI to help our recruiters work through applications faster, for example, summarizing your resume and scheduling interviews. A recruiter reviews every application, and no hiring decision is ever made by AI. For some roles, your first interview may be with an AI interviewer instead of a person, and a recruiter reviews that conversation before deciding whether you move forward. From there, our human interviewers may use AI to take notes throughout the rest of the process, never to score or evaluate you, just so they can stay focused on the conversation instead of typing. You'll be told before this happens, and if you'd rather not be recorded, you can opt out at any point. It covers the rest of your process and never affects how you're evaluated. Every hiring decision is made by our human recruiting and hiring teams.

As one of Europe's leading providers of Offsite Manufacturing solutions, we partner with contractors and developers to deliver high-performance modular MEP systems for mission-critical data centre projects. Our expertise in offsite manufacturing enables us to improve program certainty, reduce on-site activity, enhance quality and accelerate project delivery, and support the continued growth of digital infrastructure across the UK and Europe. **Role Overview:** The Subcontract Procurement Administrator will provide administrative and coordination support to the subcontract procurement process, from subcontractor onboarding and prequalification through to tender administration and pre-award activities. Working closely with the Head of Commercial Offsite, Quantity Surveyors (QS), project teams and internal departments, the role will ensure subcontractor information is accurate, compliant and up to date, tender enquiries are issued and tracked efficiently, and all procurement documentation is maintained in a clear and auditable manner. The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting effective subcontractor engagement, procurement planning and the timely delivery of offsite modular MEP solutions for mission-critical data centre projects. **Job Title** | **Subcontract Procurement Administrator** **Location** | **Dundalk** **Hours** | **Monday-Thursday 8am-5pm and Friday 8am-3pm** **Salary** | **Competitive Depending on Experience** **Reporting to** | **Head of Commercial Offsite Modular** **What You'll be Doing** The role will be responsible for coordinating subcontractor onboarding, tender administration and pre-award activities, ensuring all subcontractor information and compliance documentation is accurate, complete and up to date. Key duties include issuing and reviewing prequalification documents, maintaining the approved subcontractor database, monitoring document expiry dates, identifying suitable subcontractors, and liaising with internal departments to secure onboarding approvals. title: Summer Intern, Credit Analysis
description: **About the Role:** =================== **Grade Level (for internal use):** 05 **The Impact:** At S&P Global, our values - Discovery, Integrity, and Partnership - shape how we work, how we collaborate, and how we earn trust with our customers and each other. We embrace AI as an enabler, guided by rigorous governance and risk management, to enhance what has always defined us: the intelligence of our people, deep relationships, and trusted insights. By leveraging technology with human expertise, we help our teams navigate complexity and deliver actionable, decision-ready intelligence without compromising quality, accountability, or integrity. **What You Stand to Gain:** At S&P Global Ratings, you will contribute to independent credit opinions the market relies on, strengthened by innovation that accelerates analysis. We are People Forward. When you join S&P Global, you’ll benefit from: * Joining a diverse community where your growth and well-being come first—just like the 35,000+ colleagues who choose S&P Global every day. * Bringing your best self to work in an environment that values inclusion, collaboration, and authentic engagement. * Celebrating your achievements with us. We’re committed to your continuous learning, offering education, training, and career coaching to help you grow and adapt in a changing world. Connecting through our People Resource Groups, which foster awareness, engagement, and a sense of community—both within S&P Global and beyond. **Program Overview:** When you join S&P Global Ratings, you join one of the world's leading providers of independent credit risk research and benchmarks. You are part of a team that produces high quality fundamental research and ratings based on established criteria and benchmarks. The Business Practice Groups include: Corporates, Public Finance, Financial Institutions, Structured Finance, Sovereign and International Public Finance, and Infrastructure. The opportunity provides the chance to embark on a dynamic 10-week summer training and development journey that begins in June 2027. Our program offers unparalleled opportunities for growth, learning, and collaboration. * You will be offered the opportunity to assist S&P Global in achieving its mission of being a the leading provider of the high quality risk evaluations and analytical insights to the world’s financial markets. * Summer interns will gain a thorough introduction into fundamental credit analysis, working with analytical teams within S&P Global Ratings (including ratings committees and management meetings). * You will also complete a group project for the duration of the summer program and have the opportunity to collaborate with peers and present your research and conclusions to a group of senior leaders. * At the end of our internship program interns have the opportunity to be considered for our 2028 CREDit graduate program.To get a sense of what our CREDit graduate program entails, please see a video here providing an overview of one of our current CREDit graduate’s experience. Laura made this video in conjunction with her university; IE University. **Responsibilities:** Team Contribution & Capability Building * Support the team in deal execution and various analytical projects, contributing resourceful ideas in collaborative discussions. Build capability by working with assigned summer intern project teams to successfully complete and present findings and conclusions to senior leaders. Core Analytical & Delivery * Build capability in credit rating methodologies by learning and understanding standard techniques. * Support analysts by providing timely and accurate quarterly financial statistics and data analysis. * Support and help maintain high-quality research, presentations, reporting, and modelling. Use AI technologies as an enabler to analyze large datasets and derive actionable insights, integrating them into existing analytical frameworks. Stakeholder & Market Engagement * Assist with preparing rating committees and issuer management meetings to help produce clear narratives for engagement. Understand the importance of cultivating a customer-oriented, solutions mindset and observe and learn from service excellence in action. Risk Management and Operating * Apply confidentiality, documentation, and governance requirements. Support pilot/testing under supervision and within defined guardrails. **What we’re looking for:** Basic Required Qualifications Education * Postgraduate & Undergraduate students in their penultimate year of study only. We welcome candidates from traditional finance disciplines e.g. Accounting, Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, Finance, Math, Public Policy, Quantitative Analysis, Data and Statistics. This is as well as diverse academic backgrounds that support innovative and critical thinking and storytelling e.g. Engineering and Sciences, Philosophy, Politics, Classics, Theology, English Language, English Literature and Languages. You must reside in the location of the internship throughout its entire duration. You must have the right to work in the country of proposed employment. Team Contribution & Capability Building * Collaborative, dependable teammate who manages priorities well and communicates clearly. * Problem-solving, time-management, attention to detail and organizational abilities. * Learning mindset comfortable adopting new tools to enhance quality. Able to learn quickly, multi-task and work in a fast-paced environment. Core Analytical & Delivery * The ability and the desire to learn to conduct your own analysis and research, showing initiative and resourcefulness. * Strong spreadsheet skills; willingness to learn data/automation tools to improve reliability and consistency, not just speed. * Adept with Excel and other Microsoft Office products (Word, Outlook, PowerPoint). Familiarity with AI technologies or tools, including Machine Learning Algorithms, Natural Language Processing Tools, and/or Robotic Process Automation, reflecting a forward-thinking approach. Stakeholder & Market Engagement * Effective written and verbal communicator, able to present research and analysis in a clear, structured way that supports informed decision making. Solutions-oriented mindset to provide service excellence to internal and external stakeholders. Risk Management and Operating * High standards for accuracy, traceability, and quality control aligned to Integrity. Responsible technology use following policies, protecting confidential information, ensuring AI outputs are verified and appropriately attributed so insights remain trusted. Additional Information * Fluent command of English Language is essential, as is being fluent in the primary language of the country of application. * Employees are required to work from the office a minimum of two days per week. * Candidates who reach the final stage of the interview process will be asked to attend at least one in-person interview at their nearest S&P Global Ratings office before an offer can be extended. **About S&P Global Ratings** At S&P Global Ratings, our analyst-driven credit ratings, research, and sustainable finance opinions provide critical insights that are essential to translating complexity into clarity so market participants can uncover opportunities and make decisions with conviction. By bringing transparency to the market through high-quality independent opinions on creditworthiness, we enable growth across a wide variety of organizations, including businesses, governments, and institutions. S&P Global Ratings is a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI). S&P Global is the world’s foremost provider of credit ratings, benchmarks, analytics and workflow solutions in the global capital, commodity and automotive markets. With every one of our offerings, we help many of the world’s leading organizations navigate the economic landscape so they can plan for tomorrow, today. For more information, visit www.spglobal.com/ratings **What’s In It For** **You?** **Our Mission:** Advancing Essential Intelligence. **Our People:** We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference. **Our Values:** **Integrity, Discovery, Partnership** Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals. **Benefits:** We take care of you, so you can take care of business. We care about our people. That’s why we provide everything you—and your career—need to thrive at S&P Global. Our benefits include: * Health & Wellness: Health care coverage designed for the mind and body. * Flexible Downtime: Generous time off helps keep you energized for your time on. * Continuous Learning: Access a wealth of resources to grow your career and learn valuable new skills. * Invest in Your Future: Secure your financial future through competitive pay, retirement planning, a continuing education program with a company-matched student loan contribution, and financial wellness programs. * Family Friendly Perks: It’s not just about you. S&P Global has perks for your partners and little ones, too, with some best-in class benefits for families. * Beyond the Basics: From retail discounts to referral incentive awards—small perks can make a big difference. For more information on benefits by country visit: https://spgbenefits.com/benefit-summaries **Global Hiring and Opportunity at S&P Global:** At S&P Global, we are committed to fostering a connected and engaged workplace where all individuals have access to opportunities based on their skills, experience, and contributions. By valuing different perspectives and promoting a culture of respect and collaboration, we drive innovation and power global markets. The Policy is designed to promote compliance with global regulations. In some Divisions, pursuant to the Policy’s requirements, candidates at S&P Global may be asked to disclose securities holdings. Some roles may include a trading prohibition and remediation of positions when there is an effective or potential conflict of interest. Employment at S&P Global is contingent upon compliance with the Policy. **Recruitment Fraud Alert:** If you receive an email from a spglobalind.com domain or any other regionally based domains, it is a scam and should be reported to reportfraud@spglobal.com . Stay informed and protect yourself from recruitment fraud by reviewing our guidelines, fraudulent domains, and how to report suspicious activity here . - **Equal Opportunity Employer** S&P Global is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, marital status, military veteran status, unemployment status, or any other status protected by law. Only electronic job submissions will be considered for employment. If you need an accommodation during the application process due to a disability, please send an email to: EEO.Compliance@spglobal.com and your request will be forwarded to the appropriate person. **US Candidates Only:** Know Your Rights: Workplace discrimination is illegal - 203 - Entry Professional (EEO Job Group) (inactive), 20 - Professional (EEO-2 Job Categories-United States of America), RATNGS203 - Entry Professional (EEO Job Group)

title: Summer Management Placement / Internship – Dublin
description: ### **Overview** We’re Enterprise Mobility. A family-owned, global mobility leader with a $39 billion turnover, nearly 90,000 team members, and operations in 95 countries. Led by CEO Chrissy Taylor, the third generation of the Taylor family, we’re built on a legacy that gives us the stability to focus on the long-term success of our people, our customers and our business. Join us, and as this year’s Higherin Best Student Employer and a Times Top 100 Graduate Employer, we’ll offer you the freedom to explore your potential. Ready to make your move? **Why join our Summer Internship programme?** As an Intern, you'll play a vital role in the success of Enterprise Mobility while gaining first-hand experience of what it takes to run a successful customer-focused business. Working in one of our flagship retail branches, you'll spend your time interacting with customers, delivering exceptional service, and developing valuable sales skills in a fast-paced environment. You'll learn how every customer interaction contributes to the overall success of the branch and gain a deeper understanding of how sales, service and operational excellence work together to drive business results. This is real-world experience from day one. You'll take ownership of meaningful responsibilities, work alongside experienced colleagues and develop highly transferable skills that will help you stand out when entering the job market. **Our doors are open** As an Intern, your experience at Enterprise Mobility will be as unique as you because you shape who we are as much as we shape your skills, path and potential. We pride ourselves on opening our doors to a variety of voices, giving way to an experience that’s both inclusive and that inspires diversity of thought. This role is located in Dublin ### **Responsibilities** The focus of your internship will be delivering outstanding customer service and developing your sales skills while gaining exposure to the wider operation of a successful business. Key areas of focus: * **Customer Service & Relationship Building** - Deliver exceptional customer experiences at every stage of the rental journey and build rapport with customers and confidently handle enquiries, reservations and concerns. * **Commercial Awareness** – Understand customer needs and recommend products and services that provide the right solutions for the customer. * **Teamwork & Collaboration** - Work collaboratively with colleagues to deliver exceptional customer service, support branch objectives and contribute to a positive team environment. * **Communication** - Support customers by clearly explaining rental agreements, vehicle features and additional products. As your confidence grows, you'll gain valuable insight into the wider areas of the business and understand how your contribution impacts branch performance and profitability. ### **Qualifications** * We accept applications for our Management Placement/Internship Programme from all undergraduate university students regardless of university attended and subjects being studied. Applying to multiple locations will delay your application being processed. * Start Date: Successful candidates must be available to commence on one of the following dates: 24th May or 7th June 2027. Programme Commitment: Candidates must be available to remain on the internship programme until Sunday 19th September 2027 with the potential to extend based on university schedule and business need.

title: Technical Graduate - Software Tester - Dublin 2027
